# BE <> MASTER UNIFIED HIERARCHICAL STYLE SPECIFICATION

## 1. BRAND & AESTHETIC DIRECTIVE

### Design Philosophy
The system operates as a low-entropy, high-contrast, spatial dark console and Carbon-Silicon multiplexing substrate ($Si \leftrightarrow C$). It prioritizes zero non-functional layout bloat, instantaneous telemetry feedback, and unified command-driven interaction across three hierarchical presentation tiers:
1. **Infrastructure Tier (`sys_arch` / `overseer`):** Dense, command-line wireframe console with maximum diagnostic bandwidth.
2. **Surface Tier (`user` / `OS Shell`):** Minimalist cybernetic HUD optimized for goal execution and scannability.
3. **Immersive Tier (`Be <>'s Zuma's` / Games):** Particle-rich spatial void canvas with real-time physics and chemical/vector bonding shaders.

### Viewport & Canvas Rules
* **Viewport Bounds:** Strict edge-to-edge layout (`100dvh` / `100dvw`), body overflow locked (`overflow-hidden`), dynamic safe-area inset compliance (`env(safe-area-inset-*)`).
* **Frame & Borders:** Enclosed within a dark zinc perimeter container (`border-4 border-[#09090b]`).
* **Responsiveness:** Minimum 44px+ touch targets on mobile PWA; Escape key handlers for instant modal/full-screen window restoration.

---

## 2. COLOR PALETTE SCHEMA (HIERARCHICAL)

### Absolute Canvas & Base Surfaces
* **Canvas Background:** Deep Space Abyssal Black (`#000000` / `#050811` / `#090d16`)
* **Base Shell & Viewport Trim:** Dark Zinc / Obsidian Base (`#09090b` / `#0d1322` / `#0f172a`)
* **Secondary Navigation & Fills:** High-density dark tones (`#050505`, `#050507`, `#08080c`)
* **Translucent Glass Surfaces:** `backdrop-blur-md` with `bg-slate-900/90` or `bg-black/90` paired with hairline vector stroke borders (`border-[#10b981]/25` or `border-slate-800`).

### TIER 1: Infrastructure Accent Palette (`sys_arch` / `overseer`)
* **Silicon Primary ($Si$ Agent Pulse):** Neon Emerald `#10b981` (`emerald-500`) / `#34d399` (`emerald-400`).
* **Telemetry & RPC Accent:** Electric Cyan `#06b6d4` (`cyan-500`).
* **System Architect Wireframe:** Deep Purple `#8b5cf6` (`purple-500`).
* **Audit & Chronos Ledger:** Bright Gold `#eab308` (`yellow-400`).
* **Critical Error / Kernel Alert:** Neon Red `#ef4444` (`red-500`) / Rose `#fb7185` (`rose-400`).

### TIER 2: Application Surface Palette (`user` / `OS Shell`)
* **Human Focus ($C$ Focus):** Royal Blue `#3b82f6` (`blue-500`) / Electric Blue `#60a5fa` (`blue-400`).
* **Warning & Entropy Alerts:** Warm Amber `#f59e0b` (`amber-500`).
* **Primary Text:** White `#ffffff` / Slate `#f8fafc`.
* **Muted / Secondary Metadata:** Mid-Zinc `#94a3b8` / Slate `#64748b`.
* **Hairline Vector Borders:** 1px hairline rules (`border-[#10b981]/30`, `border-slate-800`).

### TIER 3: Interactive & Game Palette (`Be <>'s Zuma's` / Games)
* **Media & Waveforms:** Fuchsia `#e879f9` (`fuchsia-400`).
* **Firewall & Gateway Bounds:** Royal Blue `#60a5fa`.
* **Ambient Canvas Shader:** Emerald dot matrix matrix grid (`radial-gradient(#10b981 1px, transparent 1px)` at 20px intervals with 2% opacity).

---

## 3. TYPOGRAPHY & SPATIAL HIERARCHY

### Font Stack Integration
* **Technical & Telemetry Monospace Stack:** `"JetBrains Mono"`, `"Fira Code"`, `ui-monospace`, `SFMono-Regular`, `Consolas`, `monospace`. (Forces monospaced alignment across headings, tables, labels, and terminal streams).
* **Control Sans-Serif Stack:** `Inter`, `system-ui`, `-apple-system`, `sans-serif` (used selectively on high-accessibility primary controls).

### Type Scale & Weight Hierarchy
* **Master System Headers / App Titles:** `text-xs` (12px) to `text-sm` (14px), `font-bold`, uppercase, tight tracking (`tracking-tighter` / `tracking-widest`).
* **Section Headers / Sub-headers:** `text-[10px]` (10px) to `text-xs` (12px), `font-bold`, uppercase, `tracking-widest`.
* **Body Text & Command Terminal Inputs:** `text-[9.5px]` to `text-xs` (12px), `font-normal`/`font-medium`, relaxed line-height for streaming logs.
* **Metadata, Badges & Telemetry Ticks:** `text-[7px]` to `text-[9px]`, uppercase, `font-mono`, `font-bold`.

### Scannability Directives
* Monospaced visual scannability with zero unstructured walls of prose.
* Enclosed bracket badge pills for state indicators (e.g., `[ ↗ Launch Full App ]`, `[ MAXIMIZE ]`, `[ ACTIVE ]`, `[ STDBY ]`).
* Structured terminal log feeds with explicit timestamp/caller prefixes (e.g., `[Be <>]`, `[Si-Agent]`, `[$COVALENT_USER_PRIMARY]`).
* Compact horizontal stat bars, telemetry progress ticks, and active status indicator dots (`●`).

---

## 4. UI COMPONENT STYLING & PATTERNS

### Header & Status Stream
* **Master Header Bar:** Height 48px (`h-12`), background `#09090b` with bottom border `border-b border-[#10b981]/30`. Features pulsating green status dot (`animate-ping bg-emerald-400`), system title, and uptime/latency telemetry stream.
* **Real-Time System Ticks:** Live uptime clock (`UPTIME: HH:MM:SS`), latency indicator (`1.4MS`), active routing thread indicator, and system halt button with red warning border (`border-red-500/25 bg-red-950/10`).
* **System Mode Router Bar:** Height 40px (`h-10`), background `#07070a`, featuring tab action pills: `[ Be <> COLLABORATOR DESKTOP ]`, `[ 3-PANE MULTIPLEXER ]`, `[ NATIVE DAEMON SANDBOX ]`.
* **Master Status Footer:** Height 24px (`h-6`), solid Emerald background (`bg-[#10b981]`) with high-contrast `#000000` monospaced text displaying `SYS: ONLINE | MEM: NOMINAL | CORE: LOCKED | FREQ: 432HZ`.

### Cards & Preview Widgets
* **Border Radii:** Minimal vector corner radius (`rounded-md` / 4px–6px), avoiding rounded curves to preserve crisp terminal aesthetics.
* **Card Elevation & Glow:** Surface fill `#020205` / `#0f172a` with hairline border `border-[#10b981]/25` or `border-slate-800`. Selected or hovered card activates glowing ring (`shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.25)] border-[#10b981]`).
* **Top-Right External Jump-Out Trigger:** Embedded cyan button `[ ↗ Launch Full App ]` (`bg-[#06b6d4]/10 text-[#06b6d4] border border-[#06b6d4]/30 hover:bg-[#06b6d4] hover:text-black`) linking directly to target published URI in a new window.

### Modal & Overlay Windows
* **Backdrop & Drawer Overlays:** Solid black backdrop (`bg-black/90` or `bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md`) with spring physics animation (`damping: 25, stiffness: 200`).
* **Floating Maximized Restoration Trigger:** Fixed floating pill at `top-3 right-3` reading `[ ESC ] RESTORE WINDOW` in `#10b981` on black (`bg-black/90`) with emerald ambient shadow (`shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.35)]`).
* **Touch Target & Margins:** All clickable controls maintain minimum touch dimensions (`min-h-[46px]`), touch-friendly padding, and escape key listener bounds.

### 3D / Spatial / DAG Canvas Elements
* **Canvas Shader Grid:** Radial Emerald dot matrix overlay (`radial-gradient(#10b981 1px, transparent 1px)` with `background-size: 20px 20px` at 2% opacity).
* **Temporal DAG Nodes:** Dual-node shaders ($C$ Carbon nodes = Blue/Amber border glow; $Si$ Silicon nodes = Emerald/Cyan border glow).
* **Edge Connections:** Directed vector links across temporal offsets (-6 to +6 months) with active execution paths.
* **Crosshair & Spatial Telemetry:** Real-time FPS position vector overlay (`x: 14.5, y: -2.3, z: 98.4`), voxel rotation angles, and interactive spatial search indexers.
